response.sql: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM group_rates) SELECT gr.arcref, gr.fundflux, gr.rate, gr.rate - b.avg_rate AS excess FROM group_rates gr CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
